biggest_catch: Merger risk: Blue Foundry Bank has signed an agreement to be acquired by Fulton Financial and merged into Fulton Bank; the referral program may change or end after closing.
catches: Program subject to change or discontinuation at any time without notice.
Gift cards may be taxable income; Blue Foundry may file a Form 1099-MISC.
The referrer's account cannot have been opened on the same day as the referral's account.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Blue Foundry Bank's official site (bluefoundrybank.com) advertises its Refer-A-Friend program and publishes full program terms on its own domain.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns one $25 gift card for each referred personal account and two $25 gift cards ($50 total) for each referred business account. Referring customers are capped at $500 in gift cards per calendar year.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the referrer shares a unique referral link; the referral must be a new Blue Foundry Bank customer who opens an account online using that referral link. Both the referrer's account and the referral's new account must be open, funded, and in good standing at distribution.

c4.evidence: Timing: the gift card link is delivered within 30 days of the referral opening the new account.

eligibility: Current personal or business deposit account holders of Blue Foundry Bank, age 18+; referred parties must be new customers.
notes: $500/calendar-year cap implies up to 20 personal referrals at $25 each.
numeric_basis: Per-referral gift card value of $25.00 (personal) or $50.00 (business).
payout_quote: Referred Personal Accounts will receive a $25 gift card and referred Business Accounts will receive a $50 gift card.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is a free unique link; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Gift cards may be taxable; Blue Foundry may issue and file Form 1099-MISC.

s4.note: Cap: referring customers may receive gift cards totaling no more than $500 per calendar year.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official site (observed 2026-09-23); program may be changed or discontinued at any time.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated in the official terms: the referrer shares a unique referral link and the referral opens the new account online via that link.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: be a new customer (no current or funded Blue Foundry accounts), open an account online using the unique referral link.

steps: Get your unique referral link as a Blue Foundry Bank deposit account holder.
Share the link with friends, family, or businesses.
The referral opens a new account online using your link (new customers only).
Both accounts must be open, funded, and in good standing.
Gift card link delivered within 30 days of the referral opening the account.
timing: Gift card link delivered within 30 days of the referral opening the new account.
